summary.en-US: Translate Netflix subtitles locally using your own Ollama models.

description.en-US:
LST — Local Subtitle Translate adds locally generated translations to Netflix subtitles.

LST connects to an Ollama server running on your computer and lets you choose or download a model. Subtitle translation can happen in real time, or an episode can be precomputed and cached before playback.

Features:

• Local Ollama translation with TranslateGemma 4B as the default model
• Installed-model selection and model downloads
• Real-time subtitle translation
• Full-track precomputation
• Local translation cache with per-episode storage management
• Independent Netflix, original, and translated subtitle visibility
• Customizable subtitle placement, sizing, and timing
• Persistent in-player status and quick-settings pill
• Tabbed settings navigation
• Optional status messages and detailed diagnostics

LST does not require a cloud translation service. By default, subtitle text is sent only to Ollama running at http://localhost:11434.

version.approval_notes: LST translates Netflix subtitle text with a user-operated Ollama instance. Subtitle text is sent only to the configured Ollama endpoint, which defaults to localhost:11434. The extension observes Netflix timed-text fetch/XHR responses to parse TTML or WebVTT and falls back to the rendered subtitle DOM. There is no telemetry, analytics, advertising, tracking, remote executable code, or developer-operated backend. The submitted source is readable vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS with no build or minification step. Full testing instructions are included in AMO_REVIEWER_NOTES.md in the source repository.
